editorial_intro: Blockbuster week for desi OTT — Ranveer's ₹1800-crore spy sequel hits JioHotstar, Madhuri and Triptii team up for a dark comedy on Netflix, and Mammootty-Mohanlal reunite on ZEE5.

picks.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
picks.synopsis: India's second-highest-grossing film ever finally hits streaming. Undercover agent Jaskirat Singh Rangi (Ranveer Singh) rises through Karachi's underworld as Hamza Ali Mazari, dismantling terror networks while the ISI closes in. Nearly 4 hours of edge-of-seat spy action.
picks.why_watch: ₹1800 crore at the box office — if you haven't seen it yet, now's the time. The extended OTT cut adds uncensored footage too.

picks.title: Maa Behen
picks.synopsis: A mother (Madhuri Dixit) and her two quarreling daughters (Triptii Dimri, Dharna Durgaa) discover a dead body in their kitchen, sending their already chaotic family dynamic into total freefall. Directed by Suresh Triveni.
picks.why_watch: Madhuri and Triptii in the same frame? Plus a dead body and dark comedy? This is the kind of unhinged family drama we need.

picks.title: Gullak Season 5
picks.synopsis: The Mishra family returns for another season of heartfelt slice-of-life storytelling. Shanti's brother Pinky (Gopal Datt) pays a visit to Mishra Nivas, and Anant Joshi takes over as Annu Mishra. Seven episodes of the warmth only TVF can deliver.
picks.why_watch: If you grew up in a middle-class Indian household, Gullak feels like a warm hug from home. Season 5 picks up right where you left off.

picks.title: Brown
picks.synopsis: Karisma Kapoor returns in a raw, de-glam role as Rita Brown — a disgraced, alcoholic Kolkata cop pulled back into service to hunt a serial killer targeting women. Based on Abheek Barua's novel 'City of Death'. 10 episodes of gritty noir.
picks.why_watch: The Delhi Belly director + Karisma in her most intense role ever. Kolkata practically becomes a character in this one.

picks.title: Patriot
picks.synopsis: Mammootty and Mohanlal reunite on screen for a sprawling spy thriller. Dr. Daniel James (Mammootty) uncovers a massive surveillance conspiracy and teams up with Colonel Rahim Naik (Mohanlal) and ex-officer Michael Devassy (Fahadh Faasil) to take down the mastermind.
picks.why_watch: Two legends of Malayalam cinema together after years — and Fahadh Faasil too. Mixed theatrical reception means lower expectations, which sometimes is exactly when a film surprises you at home.

picks.title: Made in India: A Titan Story
picks.synopsis: The inspiring true story of how India got its first world-class watch brand. Naseeruddin Shah as JRD Tata and Jim Sarbh as Xerxes Desai chart Titan's journey from humiliation to history — a 6-episode series about visionary entrepreneurship.
picks.why_watch: Naseeruddin Shah as JRD Tata alone is worth the watch. A Made in India story that every NRI will feel proud of.

picks.title: Office Romance
picks.synopsis: A CEO (Jennifer Lopez) finds herself unexpectedly attracted to her new company lawyer (Brett Goldstein of Ted Lasso fame). They navigate office politics and growing feelings while trying to keep things professional. Edward James Olmos reunites with Lopez as her father.
picks.why_watch: Brett Goldstein literally wrote the role for J.Lo. If Ted Lasso's Roy Kent romancing Jenny from the Block doesn't intrigue you, nothing will.

picks.title: Cape Fear
picks.synopsis: Martin Scorsese and Steven Spielberg produce this reimagining of the 1991 classic. Javier Bardem plays Max Cady, a released inmate hunting the married attorneys (Patrick Wilson, Amy Adams) who put him away. A limited series by Nick Antosca.
picks.why_watch: Scorsese + Spielberg producing, Bardem channeling pure menace. This is prestige thriller television at its most intense.

picks.title: Not Suitable for Work
picks.synopsis: Created by Mindy Kaling, this comedy follows five ambitious twentysomethings in Manhattan's Murray Hill navigating entry-level jobs, love, and the chaos of early adulthood in New York City.
picks.why_watch: Mindy Kaling's take on the desi-adjacent NYC twentysomething experience. Perfect breezy binge for the weekend.

picks.title: Rick and Morty Season 9
picks.synopsis: The interdimensional adventures of cynical genius Rick and his anxious grandson Morty continue. Season 9 started airing May 24 with new episodes dropping weekly. Already renewed for Season 10 with a movie in development.
picks.why_watch: Still the sharpest animated comedy on television. Season 9 episodes are dropping weekly through July — jump in now.
